quarterly_data.quarter: Constellation Energy press release: Constellation to Acquire Rhode Island State Energy Center (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Constellation agreed to acquire 100% of RISEC Holdings, LLC, owner of the Rhode Island State Energy Center in Johnston, R.I., from Shell Energy North America (US), L.P., a subsidiary of Shell plc. The plant is a natural-gas-fired combined-cycle facility with two combustion turbines and one steam turbine, capable of generating up to 609 megawatts; it has served the New England grid since 2002, sells electricity and capacity into the ISO New England wholesale market and is expected to become part of Constellation's merchant generation portfolio, expanding its ISO New England portfolio with flexible, dispatchable generation. CEO Joe Dominguez: as Constellation's New England customer business grows, 'we need a reliable asset that is well-positioned on both the electric grid and the natural gas pipeline system'. Closing expected after customary regulatory approvals (no date stated); price and return terms omitted.
quarterly_data.figure: up to 609 MW gas combined-cycle plant (ISO New England) to be acquired
